gaps: A CLI-only trace is functional but not enough for Braydon to test the system as a user.
The app integration path needs runnable traces before app repositories build against the substrate.
The reporting surface should make activation boundaries visible without creating direct human mutation controls.
hidden_assumptions: A static local report is enough for the first user test.
The activation trace is the right first slice because it exercises the human-through-agent operating model.
Downstream apps should wait for state-system pressure traces rather than inventing their own local state contracts.
refined_problem: Create a user-testable State System vertical where trace-run produces an inspectable report for the agent activation loop, then seed the next Speedrift tasks around pressure and cross-app integration traces.
